context.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data isolation to comply with GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR.

## Key Elements
- Patients and Clinicians (Persons interacting via Mobile/Web clients)
- EU Telehealth System (Container deployment in GCP `europe-west3`)
- US Telehealth System (Container deployment in GCP `us-central1`)
- External EU National e-Prescription Gateways and US Pharmacy Networks
- Regional Identity Providers (IdPs)

## Relationships
- Patients/Clinicians <-> Platform: HTTPS (REST/GraphQL) for data management, WebRTC for low-bandwidth video consultations
- Platform <-> External Pharmacies: Secure mTLS APIs (HL7 FHIR for US, national standards for EU)
- EU System <-> US System: Asynchronous, cryptographically signed consent-based API handshakes for data portability

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Primary cloud provider spanning `europe-west3` and `us-central1`
- Terraform / OpenTofu: Infrastructure-as-Code for regional provisioning
- ArgoCD / ConfigSync: Autonomous GitOps deployment pipelines per region
- Anthos Service Mesh: Zero-trust network policies and SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identities
- Cloud HSM and Cloud KMS: Regional customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)

## Rationale
Autonomous regional deployments with zero active runtime state guarantee complete data residency compliance for EU and US health regulations. Decoupled GitOps pipelines and regional key management eliminate cross-border data leakage risks while supporting resilient rural access.

containers.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. It enforces strict regional data residency, HIPAA/GDPR compliance, and EU MDR traceability on GCP.

## Key Elements
* Patients & Clinicians (Users)
* Web & Mobile Client Apps (Flutter/React Native)
* API Gateway (Google Cloud API Gateway / Envoy)
* Core Telehealth Service (Go / gRPC & REST)
* Video Consultation Service (Mediasoup SFU on GCE)
* AI Symptom Checker Container (Python / FastAPI + PyTorch)
* Integration Service (Java / Spring Boot)
* Databases (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL & Cloud Storage)
* Infrastructure (Google Kubernetes Engine - GKE)
* Message Broker (Google Cloud Pub/Sub)
* External Systems (EU National e-Prescription Gateways, US Pharmacy Networks, Regional IdPs)

## Relationships
* Client Apps to API Gateway via HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and WebRTC
* API Gateway to Core Telehealth Service via gRPC over mTLS (Istio service mesh)
* Core Telehealth Service to Integration Service via Google Cloud Pub/Sub (regional topics)
* Integration Service to EU Gateways and US Pharmacy Networks via REST/SOAP
* AI Symptom Checker to Core Telehealth Service via internal gRPC

## Technology Stack
* Google Cloud Platform (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`) for regional data residency
* Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) for zero-downtime container orchestration
* Istio Service Mesh for zero-trust mTLS and network policies
* Google Cloud Pub/Sub for asynchronous e-prescription messaging and resilience
* Cloud SQL PostgreSQL and Cloud Storage with CMEK for encrypted regional data persistence
* OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing and compliance auditability

## Rationale
This regionalized GCP architecture guarantees data residency compliance by isolating EU and US workloads. It ensures high availability for rural users through adaptive WebRTC streaming and resilient asynchronous messaging.

Web & Mobile Client Apps.analysis:
## Overview
[Cross-Border Telehealth Platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker across the EU and US. Built as a secure, region-aware mobile and web client to handle unstable rural internet connections and strict healthcare regulations.]

## Key Elements
* Web & Mobile Client Apps (Flutter / React Native)
* UI Layer
* Local State & Storage Manager (SQLite/Hive with AES-256 / iOS Keychain / Android Keystore)
* Video Client SDK Wrapper (WebRTC)
* API & Sync Client
* Region-Aware Routing & Localization Module
* Client-Side Feature Flagging / Kill Switch SDK

## Relationships
* Patients / Clinicians -> Web & Mobile Client Apps: Accesses consultations and features via HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and WebRTC
* Web & Mobile Client Apps -> Regional API Gateway: Communicates securely via HTTPS with strict Certificate Pinning
* Web & Mobile Client Apps -> Regional Identity Providers (IdPs): Authenticates via OAuth 2.0 with PKCE

## Technology Stack
* Flutter: Chosen for cross-platform UI consistency and native-like performance
* SQLite/Hive with Hardware Keystore: Secures offline data cache with AES-256 encryption for GDPR/HIPAA compliance
* WebRTC (Adaptive Bitrate): Enables degraded-mode video streaming below 300 kbit/s
* Cryptographically Signed Feature Flags: Ensures secure, remote kill-switch capabilities for regulatory compliance

## Rationale
[The client architecture utilizes offline-first caching and adaptive WebRTC streaming to maintain availability in rural areas with unstable internet. Strict app store distribution, hardware encryption, and regional routing ensure compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR data constraints.]

API Gateway.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. It ensures strict regional data residency, regulatory compliance, and high availability for unstable connections.

## Key Elements
- Patients and Clinicians (End Users)
- Google Cloud API Gateway / Envoy (API Gateway Container)
- Routing & Regional Affinity Controller
- Authentication & Authorization Filter
- Resilience & Rate Limiting Module
- Payload Inspection & Schema Validator
- Core Telehealth Service, Video Consultation Service, AI Symptom Checker Container, and Integration Service (Microservices)
- Regional IdPs, EU National e-Prescription Gateways, and US Pharmacy Networks (External Systems)

## Relationships
- Web & Mobile Client Apps -> Routing & Regional Affinity Controller: Sends client requests and WebRTC signaling [HTTPS/WSS]
- Routing & Regional Affinity Controller -> Payload Inspection & Schema Validator: Passes ingress traffic for validation [Internal gRPC]
- Payload Inspection & Schema Validator -> Core Telehealth Service: Forwards sanitized requests via service mesh [gRPC over Istio mTLS]
- API Gateway -> External Systems: Connects to regional e-prescription gateways and pharmacy networks [HTTPS/REST]

## Technology Stack
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`): Enforces strict geographical data residency.
- Envoy Proxy & Google Cloud API Gateway: Provides edge routing, localized multi-region deployment, and WAF protection.
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) & Istio Service Mesh: Manages microservices with strict mTLS and SPIFFE ID validation.
- JWT with Token-Embedded Consent: Enables local cryptographic authorization without synchronous database lookups.
- Native Protobuf Schema Validation: Minimizes CPU overhead for low-bandwidth connections.

## Rationale
This architecture uses localized edge instances and token-embedded consent to enforce GDPR and HIPAA data residency while maintaining performance. Native Envoy schema validation and circuit breaking secure the platform and preserve availability for unstable rural connections.

Core Telehealth Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Core Telehealth Service orchestrates cross-border video consultations, e-prescriptions, and AI symptom checking on Google Kubernetes Engine. It enforces strict regional data residency and compliance for patients in the EU and US.

## Key Elements
- **Consultation Orchestrator (Go):** Manages session lifecycles and workflow coordination.
- **E-Prescription Workflow Engine (Go):** Coordinates regional pharmacy routing.
- **Consent & Privacy Manager (Go):** Evaluates granular patient consent policies.
- **Audit & Traceability Logger (Go):** Captures immutable compliance and AI logs.
- **Infrastructure & Security:** GCP VPC Service Controls, Istio Service Mesh, Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, and Cloud KMS.

## Relationships
- **Consultation Orchestrator -> Consent & Privacy Manager:** Queries active consent [Internal gRPC via mTLS]
- **E-Prescription Workflow Engine -> Audit & Traceability Logger:** Emits compliance events [In-memory channel / internal event bus]
- **Core Telehealth Service -> Cloud SQL PostgreSQL:** Persists operational state and PHI [pgx driver over TLS]
- **Core Telehealth Service -> Video Consultation Service:** Manages video sessions [WebRTC / gRPC]

## Technology Stack
- **Go (Golang):** Chosen for low-latency performance and high concurrency in distributed GKE regions.
- **Istio Service Mesh:** Enforces zero-trust mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identities, and traffic splitting.
- **GCP VPC Service Controls:** Physically enforces regional data residency between `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.
- **Cloud SQL PostgreSQL:** Provides regional, isolated relational storage with regional connection pooling.
- **Cloud KMS & Secret Manager:** Secures PHI with customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) and runtime secret injection.

## Rationale

Video Consultation Service.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. The system enforces strict regional data residency and compliance via GCP deployment in `europe-west3` and `us-central1`.

## Key Elements
- **Patients and Clinicians**: End-users accessing the platform via mobile and web apps.
- **Web & Mobile Client Apps**: Flutter / React Native client interfaces.
- **API Gateway**: Google Cloud API Gateway / Envoy managing entry points.
- **Core Telehealth Service**: Go / gRPC & REST orchestrating workflows.
- **Video Consultation Service**: Mediasoup SFU on GCE hosting real-time adaptive WebRTC video streaming.
- **Signaling Component (Node.js/WebSocket)**: Manages peer connection negotiation and room states.
- **Media Routing Component (Mediasoup SFU/C++)**: Handles real-time packet routing, simulcast, and bitrate scaling.
- **Bandwidth Adaptation Component (Go)**: Dynamically downscales streams for degraded mode (<300 kbit/s).
- **Compliance Recording Component (C++/Python)**: Encrypts and streams session audit logs.
- **Telemetry Collector Component (Node.js)**: Gathers WebRTC stats and exposes Prometheus metrics.
- **AI Symptom Checker**: Python / FastAPI + PyTorch container.
- **Databases and Storage**: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL and region-locked Cloud Storage buckets.
- **Infrastructure**: Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Istio Service Mesh, and GCP Regional External HTTP(S) Load Balancer.

## Relationships
- Client Apps -> API Gateway [HTTPS/WSS]: Accesses platform services and real-time signaling.
- API Gateway -> Core Telehealth Service [gRPC/REST]: Routes functional requests.
- Core Telehealth Service -> Video Consultation Service [gRPC]: Initiates and manages video sessions.
- Signaling -> Media Routing [In-Process IPC]: Controls SFU worker threads.
- Bandwidth Adaptation -> Media Routing [gRPC]: Adjusts bitrates based on telemetry.
- Telemetry Collector -> Bandwidth Adaptation [In-Process IPC]: Feeds real-time network metrics.
- Media Routing -> Cloud Storage [HTTPS/SRTP]: Stores encrypted session artifacts regionally.

## Technology Stack
- **Compute & Orchestration**: Google Compute Engine (GCE) for Mediasoup SFU; Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) for containerized microservices.
- **Networking**: WebRTC with DTLS-SRTP for encrypted media; WSS for WebSocket signaling; GCP Regional External HTTP(S) Load Balancer.
- **Languages & Frameworks**: Go (Core/Adaptation), Node.js (Signaling/Telemetry), C++/Python (Media routing/Recording), Python/FastAPI + PyTorch (AI).
- **Data & Compliance**: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, Cloud Storage with CMEK via GCP Cloud KMS, and VPC Service Controls.

## Rationale
This architecture uses dedicated GCE instances with Mediasoup SFU to ensure raw UDP/WebRTC performance while deploying services across regionally isolated GCP regions (`europe-west3` and `us-central1`). Strict encryption, VPC Service Controls, and dedicated adaptation components simultaneously satisfy regional data residency mandates (GDPR/HIPAA) and low-bandwidth rural connectivity requirements.

AI Symptom Checker Container.analysis:
## Overview
The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI-driven symptom checker for patients across the EU and US. It enforces regional data residency and strict regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR) using Google Cloud Platform.

## Key Elements
- **AI Symptom Checker Container**: Python-based container running FastAPI and PyTorch on GKE.
- **API Router / Controller**: FastAPI component handling internal gRPC endpoints.
- **Preprocessing & NLP Component**: spaCy / Hugging Face component for clinical entity extraction.
- **Inference Engine**: PyTorch-based execution engine for care urgency prediction.
- **Audit & Traceability Logger**: Component capturing inputs, predictions, and model versions.
- **Model Registry Client**: Component fetching version-pinned models from regional GCP Artifact Registry.
- **Google Cloud Pub/Sub**: Message broker for asynchronous audit event emission.
- **Istio Service Mesh**: Enforces mTLS, circuit breaking, and traffic management.

## Relationships
- `Core Telehealth Service` -> `API Router`: Sends symptom analysis data [Internal gRPC with mTLS and JWT metadata]
- `API Router` -> `Preprocessing & NLP Component`: Sanitizes and extracts entities [In-memory function calls]
- `Preprocessing & NLP Component` -> `Inference Engine`: Passes clinical tokens [PyTorch tensors]
- `Inference Engine` -> `Audit & Traceability Logger`: Dispatches traceability events [Asynchronous event dispatch]
- `Audit & Traceability Logger` -> `Google Cloud Pub/Sub`: Emits audit payloads [gRPC / REST regional topics]
- `Inference Engine` -> `Model Registry Client`: Loads model weights [Local cache read]

## Technology Stack
- **Python / FastAPI**: Powers the symptom checker container API for rapid async request handling.
- **PyTorch**: Executes machine learning models for symptom analysis and care urgency prediction.
- **spaCy / Hugging Face**: Performs clinical natural language processing and tokenization.
- **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**: Orchestrates container workloads with NVIDIA T4 GPU node pools.
- **Istio Service Mesh**: Secures service-to-service communication via mTLS and provides circuit breaking.
- **Google Cloud Pub/Sub**: Decouples non-blocking asynchronous audit logging across regional topics.
- **Google Cloud KMS & Storage**: Secures data at rest with CMEK and enforces immutable object retention.

## Rationale
This architecture guarantees strict regional isolation of health data in `europe-west3` and `us-central1` to satisfy GDPR and HIPAA mandates. Furthermore, decoupling asynchronous audit logging via Google Cloud Pub/Sub and utilizing immutable storage ensures complete traceability for AI outputs required by EU MDR without compromising runtime availability or inference latency.

This architecture ensures strict GDPR and HIPAA compliance by isolating regional deployments and enforcing data residency via dedicated components. Asynchronous processing and resilience patterns maintain high availability despite unstable external gateway connections.

The Cross-Border Telehealth Platform provides secure video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US. The infrastructure architecture ensures strict data residency, regulatory compliance, and resilience for low-bandwidth users across GCP regions.

## Key Elements
- Regional GKE Clusters (`europe-west3`, `us-central1`)
- Istio Service Mesh (Ingress and Egress Gateways)
- Google Cloud VPC Service Controls
- External Secrets Operator and GCP Secret Manager
- ArgoCD (Regional GitOps instances)
- Prometheus & Google Cloud Operations Suite
- Cloud KMS (Customer-Managed Encryption Keys with regional key rings)
- cert-manager & Private CA
- GKE Workload Identity
- Falco Runtime Security

## Relationships
- API Gateway -> Istio Ingress Gateway (HTTPS/REST/gRPC): Routes external client traffic into regional GKE clusters.
- Istio Service Mesh -> Core Telehealth & AI Services (mTLS/gRPC): Secures internal container-to-container communication.
- Regional GKE Clusters -> Cloud KMS (Internal GCP APIs via VPC-SC): Performs region-locked cryptographic operations for data-at-rest encryption (BYOK).
- Istio Service Mesh (Egress) -> External Consent Validator (mTLS/gRPC): Inspects and authorizes cross-region (EU-US) payloads using patient consent tokens.

## Technology Stack
- Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE): Orchestrates containerized workloads across regional boundaries.
- Istio: Manages zero-trust service mesh networking, mTLS, and cross-border traffic governance.
- GCP VPC Service Controls: Establishes hard network perimeters to prevent cross-region data exfiltration.
- Cloud KMS: Provides region-isolated Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) for data-at-rest.
- cert-manager: Automates short-lived X.509 certificate management for mesh security.
- Falco: Delivers real-time kernel-level runtime threat detection within Kubernetes.

## Rationale
This architecture uses regional isolation, hard network perimeters, and zero-trust mesh routing to strictly enforce GDPR and HIPAA data residency requirements. It integrates robust observability, automated GitOps, and workload identity to guarantee high availability and cryptographic accountability across borders.
